title: Kit Store Graph — Root Snapshot + Ordered Semantic Ops
summary: 🧩 Persist one materialized kit graph (root snapshot) plus a single append-ordered semantic op log. Checkpoints, drafts, and transactions are thin lifecycles over the same op records (forwards/backwards pairs are derived when applying ops, not second-class persistence). Readable heads (wip / stage / authoritative) are pointers into checkpoint + draft state machines.

rootSnapshot.description: Exactly one canonical kit aggregate at a chosen revision; backbone TipState merges snapshot + applied op suffix.
rootSnapshot.shape: Bundle field `rootSnapshot.kit` mirrors the portable kit DTO (types, designs, pieces, …) used by codegen and GraphQL kit resolvers.

semanticOpLog.description: Ordered array of persisted records: stable id, operation kind string, and JSON input payload (the same payload family as RS `op` command inputs).
semanticOpLog.ordering: Total order is list order; replay is deterministic when ops are applied in sequence from the root snapshot.
semanticOpLog.inverseNote: Undo stacks store inverse ops or inverse inputs; either can be regenerated from snapshot+forward knowledge — stores may still persist inverse sequences for O(1) rollback.

checkpoint.wraps: Ordered semantic change groups; each group references op ids from `semanticOpLog` (not embedded duplicate kit trees).

draft.wraps: Checkpoint pointer + ordered transactions; each transaction references op ids in log order.

transaction.wraps: Ordered forward op ids; backwards companion is derived or listed symmetrically like today’s `Change` entity.

graphqlSurface.summary: 🌐 `semio/graphql/schema.graphql` (SDL emitted from `semio/rs` async-graphql) exposes `Query.readableKitGraph(selector)` companion `wip`/`authoritative` shorthands, `Graph.{semanticOpLog,projectionFingerprint,rootSnapshotHash}`, lifecycle `semanticOpRecordIds` / `orderedTransactionIds` on checkpoint/draft/transaction/change, `Mutation.{*,backboneAttach,backboneDetach}` returning `Command` plus `SubscriptionRoot.commandSucceeded`, and `BackboneCapabilitySet` for dev JSON vs `.semio/` without SQL.
